title: Protection of Women in Olympic and Amateur Sports Act of 2026
short_title: Protection of Women in Olympic and Amateur Sports Act of 2026
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-02-05 -> Markup By 2026-02-03 -> Reported By 2026-02-17
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 423.
summary: Protection of Women in Olympic and Amateur Sports Act This bill requires certified national governing bodies (NGBs) of amateur sports (e.g., USA Gymnastics) to prohibit a person whose sex is male from participating in an amateur athletic competition that is designated for females, women, or girls. Under the bill, male  means an individual who has, had, will have—or would have, but for a developmental or genetic anomaly or historical accident—the reproductive system that at some point produces, transports, and utilizes sperm for fertilization.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
